about_the_game:
TurboSquad is a multiplayer party game where you need to sabotage a race by placing traps and using a wide variety of weapons. You can play solo, online or locally with your friends!

Take on the role of a saboteur paired with a not-so-bright AI pilot in fast-paced races. The goal? Make your driver win at all costs!

Set traps, dynamite ambushes or surprise shortcuts — anything goes, use your sneakiest tactics!

Play solo or jump into multiplayer mayhem with up to four players. Join the same squad in Team Co-op or go all out in Free For All mode. Splitscreen is also supported!

Rig the track with traps before each race to surprise your opponents and to give your driver the edge. Will you buy punching gloves, missile turrets or traffic lights? Give the game some boosts and booms!

Think fast and stay sharp because every second counts and victory is not guaranteed until the end! Trigger your traps, protect your driver and sabotage your rivals’ plans!

Anyone can pick it up, but only the smartest will thrive! Surfing behind cars, timing your boosts, orchestrating the perfect ambush and crossing the finish line first will require wit and skill. 

Will you target the drivers or focus your efforts on the saboteurs? Disarm enemy traps or lay down even trickier ones?

With endless strategies, the choice is all yours!

Race through colorful circuits packed with chaos! From the lush fields of Mount Boom to the scorching Cactus Valley desert and the charming seaside town of Hilly Island, unexpected twists lurk around every turn.

Beware — An ingenious trap could be right around the corner!

  • Epic Car Surfing Hitch a ride, surf behind cars and look ridiculously cool while doing it!

  • Flexible Play Modes Go solo against bots, compete online in multiplayer, or team up in local co-op for maximum fun. You can also join an online game with multiple local friends!

  • Rich Gameplay Arm yourself with crazy weapons and discover overpowered traps. Outbid higher than your opponents to claim bonuses during the race!

  • Wacky Duos Meet zany characters like Poulette and her egg, Ninja & Panda, or the inseparable Mr. & Mrs. Potato!

  • Varied Tracks Race on circuits packed with loops, ramps, and countless surprises to keep the chaos coming.

TurboSquad is still in early and active development. If you want to follow the adventure, add the game to your wishlist and join our discord server! We are working hard to add more content: new maps, new weapons, new characters, new features! Don’t miss that out!
